digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified CI workflow on GitHub Actions
propositions: Gerrit Verified wall-clock time increased from 15–20 minutes to 30–40 minutes due to macOS pytest execution growth (+870.72s measured) from ~91,205 net added test lines and ~4.1k additional default tests, not directly from mutation-testing addition.

Six named unit tests execute expensive real-world mechanics repeatedly (120s JIRA field waits, five 5s sleeps, 15s retry loops, 25s AST parses, repeated lru_cache fills per xdist worker, 90s+ event persistence) without production coverage justification.

Mutation-testing selector landed 2026-08-12 but did not extend critical path (0m direct addition in 62 runs) and was skipped in 57/62 runs; it increased aggregate runner usage in ~8% of sample but cannot explain the 14m31s pytest growth.

macOS/process contention amplifies deterministic work under GitHub Free org limits (5 concurrent macOS runners); org queuing added up to 27.57m median 0.72m; targeted instrumentation rejected historical 35s editor-startup attribution, finding editor phases max 3.927ms.

Current CI long poles include wiki corpus setup (149.13s), editor loopback setup (35.04s), bridge hourly-cadence (130.59s), whole-tree provenance setup (46.95s–49.02s), and distributed work across 12,914 default tests under subprocess/APFS nonlinear contention.

Seven decomposed remediation tickets (albinic-kyanite-goldeneye, coed-defectible-muskox, analogical-dashing-fennecfox, harmless-wavy-osprey, curricular-mean-cuckoo, despotic-dorsal-greatdane, classless-dainty-lamprey) target coverage-neutral time reduction without increasing runner parallelism or aggregate consumption.
